ravi: dropping a new microflow for the latency dashboard: brief feature 1111 Sampling presets (Low noise / Balanced / Full fidelity) + a keyboard-friendly compact slider. want thoughts on label clarity and the interaction model. screenshots in thread. sasha: looks promising. small naming nit: "Low noise" sounds like it might hide problems. maybe "Smoothed (low noise)" or "Aggressive sampling"? we should avoid implying were hiding issues. nadia: agree with sasha. also callout: p95 is sensitive to tail events. microcopy should mention that presets change variance, not the underlying p95 metric. users often assume sampling changes the metric. dave: UX idea: when a preset is active show an inline pill: "Smoothed: 10% sampled" with an info icon that opens the tooltip. tooltip copy idea: "Sampling reduces point density to smooth visual noise. It does not modify stored raw metrics." thoughts? a11y-bot: a11y checklist: presets must be focusable buttons with aria-pressed; slider must expose aria-valuemin/valuemax/valuenow; ensure tooltip accessible via keyboard and dismissible with ESC. ravi: good catches. will adopt "Smoothed (10%) / Balanced (50%) / Full fidelity (100%)" labels so percent is explicit. also will include the pill/dismiss pattern. sasha: interaction question: if a user adjusts the slider after selecting a preset, do we show "custom" state? i'd prefer the preset button to visually switch to a muted "custom" with a small reset link. prevents confusion. dave: yes to custom state. add a toast-ish ephemeral message the first time someone goes custom: "Sampling set to custom. Use Reset to return to presets." small and dismissible. nadia: analytics: log events: sampling_preset_selected and sampling_custom_set with anonymized route and cohort. also include p95 delta preview sample before/after so Optimize can suggest presets later. be cautious about storing raw metric values in analytics. aggregate only. a11y-bot: keyboard flow suggestion for eng QA: 1) Tab to Sampling area, 2) Arrow keys to cycle presets, 3) Enter to apply, 4) Tab to slider, 5) Arrow left/right to change %, 6) Press ESC to close tooltip. Provide ARIA live region updates when presets change. ravi: implementation snippet for preset buttons: ```html
``` please note we should animate transitions subtly to avoid motion triggers. sasha: copy tweak for tooltip: "Sampling reduces plotted points to make trends clearer. Higher sampling preserves more detail; lower sampling reduces noise." keep it very short. dave: visual ask: when presets are used, add a subtle badge next to the p95 label: "smoothed" with an info microcopy on hover. also ensure the legend indicates sampling % next to series name. nadia: accessibility note: the badge must be programmatically associated with the chart via aria-describedby so screen readers understand the visual modifier. a11y-bot: test cases to include: screen-reader walkthrough, keyboard-only preset selection, high-contrast color check for the badge, reduced-motion preference respected. ravi: perfect. my action items: 1) update labels to Smoothed/Balanced/Full fidelity with explicit percents, 2) add custom state + reset, 3) implement small pill + aria-describedby hookup, 4) include analytics events (aggregated), 5) add keyboard flow doc and test cases. i'll post revised mocks tomorrow morning. thanks all :sparkles:
